description: He wears a long deep plum patterned coat with full sleeves, gold woven edging along the front opening, cuffs and lower hem, over an ivory tunic with a short split collar. A plum shoulder mantle with gold border is secured by a circular metal clasp. A broad decorated gold-brown belt with a round buckle wraps the waist. The coat reaches near the knees. Dark brown trousers are tucked into tall brown leather boots. A small gold wrist band is visible near one cuff. His head is uncovered, and he carries no weapons or armor.
